entries.chosen_caption:
舌尖忘記收回去了。
反正也沒有人在看。

Forgot to put the tongue back.
Not like anyone is paying attention anyway.
rejected_captions:
人類設計的三角形，看久了有點催眠。
手不知不覺就交疊在一起了。

Staring at these triangles makes one sleepy.
Paws crossed themselves without permission.

左上角那個黑點，到底是灰塵還是蚊子。
有人知道嗎。

Is that black speck on the wall dust or a bug.
Any guesses.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三色貓趴在印有幾何三角形圖案的椅墊上，前肢呈現交叉的姿勢。牠睜大雙眼朝左上方看去，嘴巴微張並露出一點粉紅色的舌尖。背景是單純的藍灰色牆面，整體光線均勻充足。

entries.chosen_caption:
世界歪著看好像比較合理。
要不要一起歪著頭試試。

Maybe the world makes more sense tilted.
Want to tilt your head and see?
rejected_captions:
紫色格子有點硬。
不過躺久了也就這樣。

This purple grid is a bit stiff.
But it feels okay after lying here for a while.

鏡頭貼得太近了。
連鼻頭上的黑點都看得清清楚楚。

The camera is a bit too close.
Even the spots on the nose are visible now.
entries.photo_description: 一隻橘白相間的貓咪側躺在紫色的網格紋路地墊上，頭部向右側傾斜，雙眼睜圓注視著鏡頭。貓咪的鬍鬚和臉部毛髮細節清晰，粉紅色的鼻頭上有少許黑斑。背景是稍微模糊的室內房間，可以看到粉紅色的寵物提籠、椅腳和櫃子。

entries.chosen_caption:
肚子曬黑了也無所謂。
沙發寬度剛剛好，適合把肚皮翻過來，徹底忘記今天星期幾。

Belly up is the only correct way to sleep.
This sofa gets it.
rejected_captions:
桌上的扇子和筆動都沒動過。
人類好像總是很忙，躺著其實什麼都不會發生。

The fan on the table hasn't moved all day.
Humans are always busy, while doing nothing is actually quite simple.

翻過來躺著比較舒服。
一直規規矩矩地趴著，難道不累嗎。

Sleeping belly up is just better.
Don't you get tired of always staying upright.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓仰躺在淺灰色的沙發椅面上，閉著眼睛呈現睡眠狀態。牠的身體緊貼著沙發靠墊，腹部朝上翻出，後腿與尾巴自然舒展。背景上方露出大理石紋路桌子的一角，其放置著原子筆與扇子。

entries.chosen_caption:
週日宜躺躺。

Lying down is enough for today.
rejected_captions:
磁磚上有一點影子的輪廓。
躺在這裡看，世界好像比較安靜。

Just watching the faint shadows on the tiles.
The world seems quieter from down here.

大理石地板的溫度很剛好。
不一起躺下嗎？

The marble floor is at the perfect temperature.
Why are you still standing?
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花色斑紋的貓咪側躺並伸展身體在淺色的大理石磁磚地板上。貓咪的頭部朝向左上方且背對鏡頭，呈現放鬆的睡姿。室內光線溫和均勻，磁磚表面映照出微弱的光影與貓咪輪廓。

entries.chosen_caption:
打哈欠會傳染。

螢幕對面的，現在嘴巴開開的嗎？

Yawns are contagious.

Is your mouth open right now?
rejected_captions:
手伸直，交叉疊好。
哈欠打完，今天的大事就算忙完了。

Paws crossed.
Yawning is the most productive thing to do today.

桌上的雜物堆了幾天都沒動過。
人類的生活，常常停滯在奇怪的地方。

Those things on the table haven't moved for days.
Humans have an odd way of leaving things behind.

沙發軟得剛好。
嘴巴張到最大，能把下午的睡意都吐出來嗎。

The sofa is just soft enough.
If the yawn is wide enough, will the afternoon sleepiness go away.

嘴巴張得太大，風就自己跑進來了。

沙發很軟，今天到此為止。

Yawned too wide and swallowed some air.

Done for the day on this couch.

雙腳交叉放好，算是給沙發一點尊重。

那邊的雜物堆，看起來還是很礙眼。

Paws crossed to show some respect to the sofa.

That messy side table is still an eyesore.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓趴在米灰色的沙發上，雙前肢向前伸直交叉，正張大嘴巴打哈欠並露出舌頭與牙齒。沙發左側有一個淺灰色大抱枕遮擋部分視線，背景可見木製扶手椅以及放有水瓶、筆等雜物的邊桌。室內光線柔和，焦點集中在貓咪面部。

entries.chosen_caption:
嘴巴稍微張開比較容易看清楚。
上面有罐罐嗎。

Keeping the mouth open helps to see better.
Is there a can up there?
rejected_captions:
盯著天花板看久了，忘了把舌頭收回去。
其實上面什麼都沒有。

Staring at the ceiling for too long. Forgot to pull the tongue back.
Nothing is up there anyway.

這塊墊子的花紋有點催眠。
人類在前面拿著相機揮手，不知道在興奮什麼。

This cushion pattern is a bit hypnotic.
Someone is waving a camera over there, looking way too excited.

上方好像有奇怪的亮光。
今天的天花板，也是空的嗎？

Thought there was a light up there.
Is your ceiling empty today too?

看著天花板發呆。舌頭好像忘記收回去了。

Staring at the ceiling. Forgot to put the tongue back.

人類又拿著相機走過來。其實上面什麼都沒有。

Human is coming over with a camera again. There is actually nothing up there.

這塊墊子軟硬剛好。天花板到底有什麼好研究的？

This cushion is just right. What is so interesting about the ceiling anyway?

舌尖忘了收回去。
上面那個會動的影子到底是什麼。

Forgot to put the tongue back.
What is that moving shadow up there.

這塊墊子的花紋有點複雜。
人類選東西的眼光總是特別奇怪。

The pattern on this cushion is a bit busy.
Humans have strange taste in things.
entries.photo_description: 一隻橘白相間的貓咪趴在有著幾何圖案的軟墊上。牠睜大圓圓的黃綠色眼睛抬頭往上凝視，嘴巴微張並稍微露出粉紅色的舌尖。背景為室內的白牆與一處門廊，整體光線明亮柔和。

entries.chosen_caption:
這條魚是叫不醒了。
要一起躺著嗎。

This fish is not waking up.
Want to lie down together.
rejected_captions:
抱著這條魚的時候，時間過得比較慢。
沙發和魚都是灰色的，剛好適合發呆。

Time slows down when hugging this fish.
Grey sofa, grey toy, perfect for doing nothing.

那個黑盒子又對過來了。
抱緊手裡的魚，免得被拿走。

That black box is pointing this way again.
Holding this fish tight, just in case.

躺著其實不需要理由。
手裡有一隻魚，不就夠了嗎？

There is no need for an excuse to lie down.
Isn't having a fish enough?

這隻魚沒有溫度，但大小剛好。
躺著就不想動了。

This fish is cold, but the size is just right.
Staying here.

鏡頭閃了一下。
其實只是抱著這隻魚，沒做什麼。

The camera flashed.
Just holding this fish, doing nothing.

沙發和魚都是灰色的。
分得出來哪裡不同嗎。

The sofa and the fish are both grey.
Can you tell the difference?

這隻魚今天特別好抱。
沙發的格子也剛好對齊了。

The fish feels right today.
Even the sofa grids are perfectly aligned.

鏡頭背後的人一動也不動。
其實抱著玩具躺著，真的沒什麼好看的。

Someone is staring behind that lens again.
It is just a cat holding a fish.

抱著想抱的東西，眼睛自然就睜大了。
你們盯著看，是因為也想抱著什麼嗎？

Staring back because this fish is mine.
Are you also looking for something to hold?

抱著這隻魚。
今天剩下的時間，都歸牠管。

Holding this fish.
The rest of today belongs to it.

又在拍了。
其實只是沙發很軟，魚很剛好。

Filming again.
Really, the sofa is just soft and the fish is just right.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓躺在灰色格紋沙發上，前肢緊緊抱著一個灰色的魚形玩偶。貓咪將臉頰貼在玩偶上，雙眼圓睜並直視鏡頭。

entries.chosen_caption:
手收埋在肚子下面。
這樣盯著看，能看出什麼嗎。

Paws are neatly tucked away.
Staring like that, what are you trying to find?
rejected_captions:
地板擦得夠乾淨。
倒影裡的那隻貓，看起來也挺閒的。

The floor is clean enough to see a reflection.
The cat down there looks just as jobless as this one.

手機鏡頭亮著。
明明什麼都沒做，那個人到底在拍什麼。

The phone lens is shining.
Why take photos when nothing is happening.

手腳都收好了。
今天地板的溫度，適合就地躺下嗎？

Paws are neatly tucked.
Is the floor temperature right for a nap today?

地板滿涼的。
倒影裡的那隻貓，姿勢倒是挺標準。

The floor is nice and cool.
That cat in the reflection has perfect posture.

鏡頭又對著這邊。
黃色的光亮著，身後那些衣服不知道整理好了沒。

The camera is pointing here again.
Under this warm light, those clothes in the back still look messy.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓趴在光滑的地板上，雙前腳往內收攏，地板上映照出貓咪的倒影。貓咪直視著鏡頭，眼神專注。背景一側有模糊的衣架與包包，光線呈現溫暖的黃色調。

entries.chosen_caption:
壓著這個就不能拿走了。

Keeping this card safe under my paw.
rejected_captions:
這張卡片畫得不像。
不過腳掌放這裡剛剛好。

The drawing on this card is off.
But it makes a decent paw rest.

鏡頭一直對著腳底板。
人類的興趣有時候很難理解。

Staring at my black paw pad again.
Humans have the strangest hobbies.

壓在底下的這張紙好像能換罐罐。
有人知道怎麼用嗎。

This card might be worth a can of tuna.
Anyone knows how to redeem it?

肉墊有點涼。
伸直放著剛剛好。

Paw pads are a bit cold.
Stretching them out feels right.

手下壓著一張畫。
人類總是喜歡看複製品。

Sitting on a paper cat.
Humans always prefer copies over the real thing.

格子椅墊坐久了會有印子。
那裡熱不熱。

Checkered cushions leave marks.
Is it warm over there where you are.

手底下這張紙印著同類。人類總是喜歡收集這些複製品。

They printed another cat on paper. Humans have strange ways of keeping company.

黑色肉墊其實挺好認的。今天有好好曬太陽嗎。

Showing off a dark paw pad today. Did anyone else catch the afternoon sun.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓趴在椅子的格子坐墊上，雙眼直視鏡頭。牠的左前肢向前伸出並露出黑色的腳掌肉墊，右前肢則壓著一張印有貓咪插畫的卡片。背景為木質椅子的直條椅背，光線充足且主體清晰。

entries.chosen_caption:
洗好的衣服果然比較適合當墊子。

Fresh laundry makes the best cushion.
Their storage system makes no sense anyway.
rejected_captions:
衣服堆的高度剛剛好。
適合在這裡發呆到天黑。

This pile of clothes is just the right height.
Perfect for staring into space until dark.

角落那疊衣服很久沒動了。
既然沒人要整理，就先收下了。

Those clothes in the corner haven't moved in days.
Since nobody is cleaning them up, they belong here now.

這疊深色衣服坐起來很暖和。
人類今天不穿這件嗎。

This pile of dark laundry is surprisingly warm.
Are you not wearing this today?

衣服堆的高度剛剛好。

This pile of clothes is just the right height.
Waiting to see if that speck of light will drop.

角落好像有東西。

Something is in the corner.
Is there anything else there besides air?
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓以坐姿端立在一疊深色衣物上，身體面向前方，頭部轉向左側並微微抬起。貓咪有著白色的胸口與前肢，頭部和背部有橘色與黑色的斑紋，正睜大眼睛注視著畫面左上方。背景光線昏暗，能看見後方的深色置物空間以及部分木製抽屜櫃。

entries.chosen_caption:
下午的光把肉墊曬得暖暖的。
這裡位置這麼好，怎麼沒人搶？

Afternoon light warmed up the paw pads nicely.
Such a prime spot, why is nobody competing for it?
rejected_captions:
沙發靠枕的高度剛剛好。
陽光進來了，那就先這樣躺著。

The cushion is at the right height.
Might as well stay here for a while.

窗外的光照得整張沙發都很軟。
人類在桌邊走來走去，好像很忙。

Daylight makes the whole couch feel soft.
Humans keep walking by the table, busy as usual.

光線剛好照在抱枕上。
今天這太陽打算曬多久？

The light hits the pillow just right.
How long is the sun planning to stay today?

沙發靠枕的高度剛剛好。
眼睛留一條縫，光線就不會太亮。

The cylindrical pillow is at just the right height.
Keeping eyes half closed keeps the room from being too bright.

陽光從大窗戶照進來。
旁邊那張木桌空著，這塊沙發比較軟。

Sunlight comes through the big window.
The wooden table nearby is empty, and this sofa is much softer.

綠色和米色的布料摸起來不太一樣。
下午待在這裡，有需要換地方嗎？

The green and beige fabrics feel slightly different.
Is there any real reason to move somewhere else this afternoon?

抱枕軟硬剛好。
眼睛瞇起來，陽光就變成一條線。

The bolster pillow is just right.
Squinting turns the sunlight into a single line.

這個位置光線選得不錯。
沙發靠著圓枕，剛好適合發呆。

Good light in this spot.
The sofa with the round pillow works well for staring into space.

靠著這枕頭剛剛好。
陽光順著沙發移過來，眼睛有點睜不開。

The pillow fits just right.
The sunlight moves across the sofa, making it hard to keep eyes open.

窗外的光線亮得均勻。
圓柱抱枕的角度合適，躺著就不太想動了。

The window light is perfectly even.
With the round pillow positioned well, moving seems unnecessary.

下午的陽光照在抱枕上格外軟。
旁邊這張木桌放著，是要準備擺罐罐了嗎？

Afternoon light makes the pillow feel softer.
Is that wooden table next to the sofa meant for food?
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓躺在米色與綠色拼接的沙發椅上，頭靠著圓柱形抱枕，眼睛微眯呈放鬆狀態。前景邊緣有一張木桌，背景為大面積的窗戶與室內採光。光線明亮均勻，貓咪蜷曲的身體與肉墊細節清晰顯現。

entries.chosen_caption:
探出頭來只是順便。這樣看過去，那邊到底有什麼好忙的？

Peeking out was just by chance. Looking from here, what is everybody so busy with over there?
rejected_captions:
樓梯縫隙的大小剛好。
趴在這裡看，時間過得比較慢。

The gap between the stairs fits just right.
Watching from here makes time move a bit slower.

金屬欄杆冰冰的。
底下那個人走來走去，不知在忙什麼。

The metal rail is cool to touch.
Someone keeps walking back and forth down there for no reason.

頭卡在這裡剛剛好。
今天樓下有什麼新鮮事嗎？

Head fits right into this spot.
Is anything interesting happening downstairs today?

樓梯縫隙剛好能放下一隻腳。
就這樣待著，暫時不想動。

One paw on the edge feels just right.
Staying right here for now.

欄杆把視線切成幾塊。
外面的世界好像沒什麼變化。

The railing splits the view in pieces.
Nothing much changes out there.

從這裡看過去剛剛好。
今天樓下有人要經過嗎？

The spot right here is quite good.
Is anyone walking down there today?

欄杆間隔剛好放下一顆頭。前腳搭著木梯，這裡視野還算清楚。

The gap between railings fits just right. One paw resting, the view is clear enough.

樓梯邊緣適合看看前方。光線均勻，木板踩著溫度剛好。

This stair edge works for staring ahead. Soft light, wood feels right.

從欄杆中間探出頭趴著正好。今天這格視野算安全嗎？

Leaning out through the railing feels alright. Safe inside this frame today?

樓梯邊緣寬度剛好。欄杆外面那些東西，看久了其實都差不多。

The edge of the stairs fits just right. Everything beyond the railing looks pretty much the same after a while.

欄杆把這裡分成了裡面和外面。腳踏在木板上，就這樣待著就好。

The railing splits this place into inside and outside. Resting a paw on the wood is enough for now.
entries.photo_description: 隻橘白相間的貓咪從木質樓梯邊緣探出頭，睜大雙眼凝視前方，一隻前腳搭在木板邊緣。畫面前方有深色的金屬欄杆，將貓咪的頭部正好框在欄杆之間。整體背景為素色牆面，光線均勻柔和。

entries.chosen_caption:
看我這邊 🖤💗。

Look at you, NOW LOOK AT ME 🖤💗
rejected_captions:
角落的雜物堆得挺有秩序。趴著看看，時間就過去了。

The clutter in the corner is piled nicely. Time just passes while lying here.

地墊的溫度剛剛好。這個時間適合拿來發呆吧？

The mat feels nice and warm. Is this time of day good for zoning out?

地墊的粉紅色有點亮。趴著看牆角，時間過得比較慢。

The pink mat is a bit bright. Watching the wall corner makes time go slower.

牆角堆著沒收拾的雜物。光線暖暖的，適合在這裡待著。

Unsorted things piled in the corner. Warm light makes this a decent spot.

趴在粉紅墊子上看前面。角落那個箱子到底放了多久？

Lying on the pink mat looking ahead. How long has that box in the corner been there?

趴在粉紅色的地墊上，視線停在角落那個沒有搬走的箱子。
日光有些晃眼，適合什麼都不想。

Lying on the pink mat, eyes fixed on that unmoved box in the corner.
The sunlight is a bit bright, perfect for thinking about nothing.

牆角的雜物堆很久了，人類似乎總喜歡留著用不到的東西。
暖光照下來，地墊的溫度剛好。

The clutter in the corner has been there forever, humans love keeping useless things.
Under the warm light, the temperature of the mat is just right.

盯著上方發呆，順便等等看會不會有食物掉下來。
下午這種光線，地板是不是比床上好躺。

Staring at the ceiling, waiting lazily to see if any food drops down.
With light like this, is the floor better than the bed.
entries.photo_description: 一隻三花貓趴伏在粉紅色的地墊上，眼睛注視著前上方。背景為室內牆面與角落雜物，整體光線呈現暖色調。
